# Creating a new CompBio or Manuscript project

Please follow the instructions in the code block carefully.

1.  In Terminal logged into H4H + compute node:

``` shell
# Create exectutable
cp setup/initProject.sh $HOME/bin/initProject.sh
# if $HOME/bin doesn't exist yet
# mkdir -p $HOME/bin
chmod +x $HOME/bin/initProject.sh

# Create project
 ./initProject.sh
Initialize a project from a GLTB template.

Usage:
    initProject.sh TYPE DESTINATION [GLTB_DIR]

Arguments:
    TYPE           Project type:
                     compbio
                     manuscript

    DESTINATION    Project directory to create.

    GLTB_DIR       Path to GaitiLabToolBox.

Resolution order for GLTB_DIR:
    1. GLTB_DIR argument
    2. GLTB environment variable
    3. Default:
       /cluster/projects/gaitigroup/Pipelines/GaitiLabToolBox

Examples:
    initProject.sh compbio my_project

    initProject.sh manuscript my_paper

    initProject.sh compbio my_project \
        /cluster/projects/gaitigroup/Pipelines/GaitiLabToolBox
```

2.  Create a repository on [github.com](https://github.com) (**private**; either personal or GaitiLab workspace)

![1792448988483](image/setup/initRepoGitHub.png)

3.  In Terminal **local** run the following:

``` shell
# Create exectutable
cp setup/initGithubRepo.sh $HOME/bin/initGitHubRepo.sh
# if $HOME/bin doesn't exist yet
# mkdir -p $HOME/bin
chmod +x $HOME/bin/initGitHubRepo.sh

./initGitHubRepo.sh ${PROJECT_DIR} ${GITHUB_REPO_URL}
```
